sections.heading: What the official release records
paragraphs: The Press Information Bureau release dated 7 November 2026 records that the Prime Minister met Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan at Uprashtrapati Bhawan and exchanged Diwali greetings. It does not report an agenda, decision, agreement or administrative direction.

sections.heading: Constitutional context and limitation
paragraphs: The Vice-President is a constitutional office and also the ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha. The office has a defined electoral framework under Article 66, including election by members of both Houses through proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.[1] These constitutional details are context, not claims made in this particular release.

sections.heading: How to use it in an answer
paragraphs: Use the event as a restrained example of institutional courtesy and India’s public cultural context. Avoid presenting it as evidence of executive-legislative coordination, a policy outcome or a change in constitutional practice.
